# Ouroboros

Ouroboros is a warm, paper-like light and dark theme covering typography, spacing, tables, callouts, code blocks, tags and metadata. Accent presets, density, heading sizes and focused modes are configurable, and the theme includes CJK typography, mobile tweaks and built-in styling for common community plugins.

![Ouroboros screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lemon695/obsidian-theme-ouroboros/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Ouroboros"
    author: "lemon695"
    repo:   "lemon695/obsidian-theme-ouroboros"
    slug:   "ouroboros"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/ouroboros"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/lemon695/obsidian-theme-ouroboros"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lemon695/obsidian-theme-ouroboros/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a warm, paper-like light and dark palette with refined typography, spacing, tables, callouts, code blocks, tags, and metadata for a calm, readable workspace. Customize accent presets, density, heading sizes, and focused modes; enable CJK typography, mobile tweaks, and built-in styling for common community plugins."
}
```
